title: The reopen-then-close guard must be pinned by tests, not only by a drill
description: the reopen-then-close guard must be pinned by tests, not only by a drill
acceptance_criteria: Removing the archive-to-active direction from the scoped review history guard, which is the defect a reopened change could never be closed again, fails a test rather than leaving the suite green; deleting the guard entirely also fails a test, and fails a different one, so neither the fix nor the refusal it lives inside can be removed silently; the refusal of a move to any location other than a change's two homes is asserted for the first time, in both directions; and deleting committed review evidence is still refused.
